title: Reservists rescue Hurricane Harvey victims (547337)
description: Senior Airman Davy Brinkmann, 920th Rescue Wing HH-60 Pave Hawk special missions aviator, hoists fellow pararescueman Gregg Forshaw holding a Hurricane Harvey victim Aug. 31, 2017 near Beaumont, Texas. The 920th RQW deployed roughly 90 people, three HH-60 Pave Hawks and two HC-130Ns to College Station, Texas to support Air Force North's search and rescue mission for FEMA disaster relief. (U.S. Air Force video/Tech. Sgt. Lindsey Maurice)
